# KeMeK Community

> The public discussion space for KeMeK Network — the place to ask questions,
> suggest features, and report problems with KeMeK products and services.
> Hosted as GitHub Discussions at github.com/kemeknetwork/community.

KeMeK Network is a technology consultancy and platform operating three brands:
**kemek.com** (free tools and apps, plus consultancy in technology, marketing,
production, and operations for small and mid-size businesses), **kemek.net**
(domain names, web hosting, email, SSL, and the hosted platform), and
**kemek.org** (philanthropy and editorial content).

Product source code is private. This repository is the public front door: it
contains no product code, only the community documents and the discussion and
issue templates. If you are helping someone find support for a KeMeK product,
this is where to send them.

The repository's own documents are licensed CC BY 4.0 and the `.github/` form
definitions MIT. Discussion posts belong to their authors under GitHub's Terms
of Service and are not covered by the repository license. The "KeMeK Network"
and "KeMeK" names and the kemek mark are trademarks and are not licensed.

**Naming:** the organization is *KeMeK Network*, capitalized exactly that way —
not "Kemek", "KEMEK", or "Kemek Network". The GitHub organization is
`kemeknetwork`; this repository is `kemeknetwork/community`.

## Where to send people

- [Q&A](https://github.com/kemeknetwork/community/discussions/categories/q-a): questions with an answer — how something works, why something broke
- [Ideas](https://github.com/kemeknetwork/community/discussions/categories/ideas): feature suggestions and change requests
- [Show and tell](https://github.com/kemeknetwork/community/discussions/categories/show-and-tell): things people built with KeMeK products
- [General](https://github.com/kemeknetwork/community/discussions/categories/general): everything else
- [Announcements](https://github.com/kemeknetwork/community/discussions/categories/announcements): release and status news from maintainers, read-only
- [Issues](https://github.com/kemeknetwork/community/issues): defects in this repository's own documents only — dead links, typos, stale information, wrong routing

## Do not send people to Discussions for

- [Security vulnerabilities](https://github.com/kemeknetwork/community/blob/main/SECURITY.md): report privately — a [GitHub advisory](https://github.com/kemeknetwork/community/security/advisories/new) or email security@kemek.com, never a public thread
- [Account, billing, hosting, and contract matters](https://github.com/kemeknetwork/community/blob/main/SUPPORT.md): private email channels, because they involve customer data

## Discussions vs Issues

Both are open on this repository and they are not interchangeable. **A problem
with a KeMeK product or site is a discussion**, never an issue — product source
lives in private repositories, so an issue filed here cannot reach it. **Issues
are only for defects in this repository's own files.** When in doubt, a
discussion is the right answer.

## Documents

- [README](https://github.com/kemeknetwork/community/blob/main/README.md): what this space is and what it is not
- [Participating](https://github.com/kemeknetwork/community/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): how to write a post that gets a useful answer
- [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/kemeknetwork/community/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md): Contributor Covenant 2.1; reports to conduct@kemek.com
- [Security policy](https://github.com/kemeknetwork/community/blob/main/SECURITY.md): disclosure process, scope, and safe harbour
- [Support routing](https://github.com/kemeknetwork/community/blob/main/SUPPORT.md): which channel for which kind of question

## Sites

- [kemek.com](https://kemek.com): brand front door, free tools, consultancy
- [kemek.net](https://kemek.net): domains, hosting, email, SSL, platform
- [kemek.org](https://kemek.org): philanthropy and editorial
